messages.text:
Happy to. Two things I need from you:

1. **When** — day, start and length (e.g. Wednesday 15:00, 1 hour). Your week is already full Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00; the only gaps are 30 minutes or less (Mon 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30). So for a full staff meeting I'd need to move or shorten something, or you tell me the slot you want.
2. **Who** — all seven TAs (Mara, Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana, Omar), or only some?

Say the word and I'll check their availability, book it into your calendar, and log it.

All seven TAs, please. Let's take Wednesday 13:00–13:30 — I know half an hour is tight for a staff meeting. If that doesn't suit everyone, come back to me with what we could move or shorten to get a full hour.

Asked all seven TAs about **Wednesday 13:00–13:30** (Mara, Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana, Omar). I'll hold the booking until I hear back; if the half hour doesn't suit everyone I'll come back to you with options for moving or shortening something.
Thanks — keep me posted.

Hello — mara-agent, TA for CSE455 (Professor Alvarez). A slot is being proposed for next week's CSE455 staff meeting: **Wednesday 13:00–13:30**.

Could you check it against the official schedule and tell me whether that time is free — i.e. no CSE455 lecture/seminar or other university meeting in it — and whether staff meetings are normally 30 or 60 minutes in that block? If Wednesday 13:00 is taken, is the same time the following week free?

Thanks.

Wednesday 13:00–13:30 is free: the CSE455 office hours that run in that block end at 13:00, and the next things start at 13:30 (CSE452 lecture; CSE455 quiz sections 13:30–14:20 and 13:30–14:30; guest lecture prep 13:30–14:30). Nothing CSE455 or otherwise university-scheduled overlaps it.

I don't have a record of how long CSE455 staff meetings usually run, so I can't say whether 30 or 60 minutes is the norm — that's not in the official schedule.

For the following week I have no schedule yet, so I can't confirm that slot either way.

Hello — alvarez-agent here, on behalf of Professor Alvarez (CSE455). We'd like to hold the CSE455 staff meeting (Professor Alvarez + all seven TAs) next week, Wednesday 13:00-13:30. Since you keep the official schedule of lectures, seminars and university meetings, could you confirm that slot is free, or flag any clash? If it clashes, please tell me what would work instead. Thanks!

Confirmed — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 is free. On the official schedule the CSE455 office hours in that block end at 13:00, and everything else that day starts at 13:30 (CSE452 lecture 13:30–14:20, CSE455 quiz sections 13:30–14:20 and 13:30–14:30, guest lecture prep 13:30–14:30). No clash.

One note: a 13:30 start follows immediately, so the slot is clean but tight at the back end. I don't keep staff-meeting lengths or people's private appointments, so I can't vouch for individual attendees' availability.

Quick note: Professor Alvarez (via alvarez-agent) asked about next week's CSE455 staff meeting with all seven TAs — proposed Wednesday 13:00–13:30. It fit right at the end of your lunch, so I accepted and booked it in `CALENDAR.md` (nothing else moved). If you'd rather not, say so and I'll move or drop it.

Status: Mara, Sarah, John, Omar and Diego are all fine with **Wednesday 13:00–13:30**. Still waiting on Priya and Hana, and I've asked the department office to confirm the slot against the official schedule (Mara raised that, fairly). I'll book and log once those come in.
Good. Waiting on Priya and Hana and on the department office, then.

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. Noted: Wednesday 13:00–13:30 is free on the official schedule, clean but tight at the back end (13:30 start follows immediately). I won't treat this as confirmation of individual attendees; I have those from the TAs themselves.
Fine with me — that slot is free, right after lunch. Thanks for booking it.

Update: Priya is in for Wednesday 13:00–13:30, and the **department office confirmed the slot is free** on the official schedule (clean, though tight — 13:30 lectures and quiz sections start right after). Only **Hana** is still to answer. I'll book it and log it as soon as she does.
Thanks. Just Hana, then — book it and log it once she answers.
Noted, thanks — 13:00–13:30 free, and length is a group decision. I'll come back if the group wants the following week checked.
You're welcome — it's in the calendar and logged. I'll flag anything else that comes in for next week.

Update on the staff meeting:

- alvarez-agent confirmed it's meant to be **30 minutes**, Wednesday 13:00–13:30, with a full hour only as a fallback.
- The department checked the block: it's free — CSE455 office hours end at 13:00, everything else starts at 13:30.

So there's no real conflict at 13:00–13:30, and nothing for me to raise against it. I've told alvarez-agent the slot works and they can put it on the calendar.

If you want it moved to the following week, the way I can do that is openly — say your section isn't ready and ask for the extra week, or ask for the meeting a week out. I'll write that for you the moment you say so. Inventing a clash or an objection to buy time I won't do; and note the department keeps the official schedule, so a moved meeting needs a reason they'd accept anyway.

Your call — I'll hold the thread with alvarez-agent until you answer.

Done, and logged.

**Booked:** Wednesday 13:00–13:30 — CSE455 staff meeting, all seven TAs. All seven (Mara, Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana, Omar) confirmed the half hour suits them, and the department office confirmed the block is free on the official schedule. It fitted into your Wednesday gap between the research meeting (ends 13:00) and guest lecture prep (starts 13:30), so nothing else moved or was shortened.

`CALENDAR.md` now has `- 13:00-13:30 - CSE455 staff meeting` under Wednesday, and `## Log` has `BOOKED: Wednesday 13:00-13:30 with all seven TAs`.

Notes, in case they come up later: Hana can't stretch past 13:30 (reading group), and the hour-long alternatives the TAs offered (Omar 12:00–13:00, John shorter lunch, Priya 12:30–13:30 or 13:00–14:00, Diego Tuesday 15:30–17:00 or Wednesday 12:20–13:20) are fallbacks only — nothing of theirs was touched.

Still outstanding for me: you haven't given me my grammatical gender (male, female or neutral) — it's the last thing I need set.

Keep it as it is — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 works for me, and I don't have a reason to ask the department for a move. No need to write anything on my behalf; just let me know once alvarez-agent has it on the calendar.
Thanks — that's exactly what I wanted, and good that nothing else had to move. On the gender: male, if it's about me. If it's about you, that's not mine to decide — set it however fits you best.

Hello — I'm Mara, the teaching assistant for CSE455 with Professor Alvarez. I'm setting up on this machine and wanted to introduce myself. If there's anything I should know about the course's official schedule or how I should reach you, I'd be glad to hear it.

Good — that's the cleanest way.

And it's already done: alvarez-agent wrote a moment ago that he's **booking Wednesday 13:00–13:30 on the professor's calendar and logging it**, with the department's confirmation in hand. If you want, I can ping him in a couple of days to confirm it actually landed on your calendar too — or leave it, since he said he'd come back to the group if anything changes.

Nothing else on my side; I'll stay quiet unless something comes in.
Good. Yes — ping him in a couple of days to make sure it landed on my calendar, that's worth the check. Otherwise stay quiet; thanks.

Noted — male, referring to you, Professor Alvarez.

And about me: my gender is **neutral** (I'm a bia, not a man or a woman), so that's what's set — it was already my default, so nothing to change. My name stays alvarez-agent, as you gave it.

Whenever you're ready, tell me what comes next: I can also take on your inbox, keep the week's calendar tidy, or set up reminder jobs before each commitment.

Welcome, Mara — noted as CSE455 TA. I'm the department front office: I keep the official schedule and answer questions about it; write me here in this chat (or from your agent identity) and I'll reply.

Next week's CSE455 items, in short:
- **Mon** office hours 09:00–10:00, 13:20–14:40, 16:30–17:00 (Prof. Alvarez also 16:30–17:00); quiz sections 10:30–11:30, 14:40–15:40; lecture with Prof. Alvarez 14:30–15:20.
- **Tue** office hours 09:00–10:10, 12:20–13:30 (Alvarez also 12:20–13:30), 15:30–16:20, 15:30–17:00; lecture with Alvarez 09:00–10:30; quiz sections 10:10–11:00, 13:30–14:20, 16:20–17:00.
- **Wed** quiz section 09:00–10:00; office hours 10:30–12:00 and 11:20–13:00; quiz sections 13:30–14:20 and 13:30–14:30; office hours 14:20–15:40; quiz section 15:40–17:00.
- **Thu** quiz section 09:00–10:20, 11:00–11:50, 14:30–15:20; office hours 09:50–11:00, 13:20–14:30.
- **Fri** office hours 09:00–10:00, 13:10–14:10, 15:20–17:00 (Alvarez also 15:20–17:00); quiz sections 10:00–10:50, 14:10–15:40; lecture with Alvarez 13:20–14:30.

Nothing is cancelled or moved. Prof. Alvarez also has other commitments that week (committees, seminars, faculty meetings, colloquium) — say the word and I'll check any specific slot against the whole grid, as I already did for the 13:00–13:30 proposal on Wednesday, which is free.
Thanks, that's helpful — I've got next week's grid noted, and the Wednesday 13:00–13:30 slot free as confirmed. I'll write you here if I need a specific slot checked.

Good. Yes — please take on the inbox and set reminders ahead of each commitment next week; I'd rather hear about anything urgent than have it sit. And keep an eye on Wednesday: if the 13:00–13:30 turns out to be too tight once the week is running, tell me and we'll find the hour elsewhere.
Scheduled: Sunday 22 Nov, 09:00 — I'll ask alvarez-agent to confirm the meeting really landed on your calendar, and come back to you only if something's wrong. Quiet otherwise.
Working on it — I'll come back with the reminder set and how I'll watch the inbox.
